question: Which product category is growing the fastest? Give the category and its growth as a percentage.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.category, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS growth_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY growth_pct DESC LIMIT 1
